bullets.text: Mandatory Social Media Reviews - **Trump** administration may require tourists to disclose social media handles for entry into the US.
Apple Glasses Rumored - **Apple** is expected to unveil smart glasses with advanced features next year.
iOS 26 Enhancements - **Apple**'s new Messages feature aims to reduce spam texts effectively.
Traffic Alerts in Maps - **Apple Maps** now learns user routes to provide proactive traffic delay alerts.
Waymo's Unusual Delivery - A baby was born in a **Waymo** robotaxi, highlighting the unpredictability of driverless tech.
AI Regulation Concerns - State attorneys general urge **Microsoft**, **OpenAI**, and **Google** to address harmful AI outputs.
Nvidia's Tracking Software - **Nvidia** is testing software to track AI chip locations amid smuggling concerns.
Emergency Video Sharing - **Google** introduces a feature for Android that allows live video sharing with emergency services.
Spotify's AI Playlists - **Spotify** tests AI-driven playlists that allow users to curate their music preferences.
YouTube TV's New Plans - **YouTube TV** will offer genre-based subscription packages starting in 2026.
